cleavage_agent.evidence: beads washed three times with 80% ethanol, and digested with r-LysC (Promega, Mannheim, Germany) at an enzyme to protein ratio of 1:100 (w/w) in 50 mM triethylammonium bicarbonate (TEAB), (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, MO) for 2 hours at 1,000 rpm, 37 °C in a thermomixer.
Subsequently, sequencing grade trypsin (Promega) was added at an enzyme to protein ratio of 1:25 (w/w) and samples were digested overnight in a thermomixer at 1,000 rpm, 37 °C.

collision_energy.evidence: ions were fragmented using higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) with a collision energy of 30%, and MS2 spectra acquired in the Orbitrap analyzer with a resolution of 30,000 and a dynamic exclusion window of 120 sec.
Following one MS1 scan from m/z 350-1200, 36 consecutive HCD MS2 scans at 30 % collision energy were performed with an isolation window of m/z 24.1 (overlap of m/z 0.5).
